capabilities: : Filter events by type and folder
extras: Open source, free, and stores all data locally.
intentEvidence: Show a timeline of everything that happens in your vault: notes, tasks, captures and canvas files.
motivation: The plugin was built based on an idea and mockup shared by u/thecroissantproject on r/ObsidianMD.
problem: Users lack a centralized, historical view of all activities within their vault, such as note edits, task completions, or file changes.
summary: A timeline viewer that tracks and displays all vault activity, including notes, tasks, and canvas changes, using both live monitoring and Git history.
